audit.whatIsWrong: Graves's Q is called 'Buckshot' in four places. It is End of the Line. Smoke Screen is also described as blinding your autos and Silver Bolts, which it does not do.
audit.why: Riot's kit names the Q End of the Line — an explosive shell that detonates after 1 second or on terrain contact, 925 range, 13s falling to 6s. Smoke Screen's text is a sight-range reduction plus impact damage and a brief slow; there is no blind and no attack-miss effect, so 'your Silver Bolts whiff' is simply false and changes how a player fights inside it. The mirror flagged the same boilerplate blind error.
audit.corrected: Name the Q End of the Line; describe Smoke Screen as cutting sight range and slowing on impact.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2 and 4 disagree with the already-applied mirror.
audit.why: Mirror landed Vayne / Vayne / Graves / Skill / Graves / Vayne / Vayne; rows 1, 3, 5 and 6 already matched. Level 1 is yours because he has one ability and New Destiny forces a reload after four bullets. Level 3 is his once End of the Line and Quickdraw are both up. Level 6 is his because Collateral Damage on 100s combos with the Q to nearly one-shot a poked Vayne.
audit.corrected: Chart: Vayne, Vayne, Graves, Skill, Graves, Vayne, Vayne, with ratings and whys[0], whys[1], whys[4] rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text carried the wrong Q name and no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: End of the Line is 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s; Quickdraw is 425 range on 16s but its cooldown is lowered by landing basic attacks, so it is not a fixed window; Collateral Damage is 100/80/60s.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into all four spikes and the do's; the first-item spike now names the 6-13s Q window as the commit point.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two real mechanics were absent: his bullets cannot pass through units, and End of the Line detonates on terrain.
audit.why: New Destiny fires 4 bullets that cannot pass through units — keeping a minion between you absorbs the shotgun and the ult line. End of the Line exploding on terrain means he can cut your retreat along a wall and you have no dash to leave with.
audit.corrected: Body-block with minions; hold Flash for a wall cut, not for damage.

edits.before: Graves out-trades Vayne at Level 1 with double-shot autos plus Buckshot burst.
edits.after: At Level 1 Graves has one ability and reloads — your autos win the first exchange.

edits.before: Smoke Screen blinds Vayne's autos and Silver Bolts, keeping the Level 2 trade Graves's.
edits.after: At Level 2 Tumble's auto reset lands your third Silver Bolt before he finishes reloading.

edits.before: At Level 6 it's still even: Collateral Damage threatens a one-shot, but a healthy Vayne can break line-of-sight with Tumble.
edits.after: At Level 6 Collateral Damage on a 100s cooldown threatens a one-shot on a poked Vayne, and Smoke Screen cuts your sight first.

edits.before: Graves out-trades you at every point early: his double-shot autos plus Buckshot (Q) burst you for over half your bar in one combo, and Smoke Screen (W) blinds you so your Silver Bolts and autos whiff. Quickdraw (E) also gives him armour stacks and a dash to dodge your Condemn — do not step up, just farm at range.
edits.after: Graves out-trades you from 3: his four-bullet autos plus End of the Line (Q) burst you for over half your bar, and Smoke Screen (W) cuts your sight range so you cannot track him. Quickdraw (E) is a 425 dash on 16s that refreshes off his autos and dodges your Condemn — farm at range instead.

edits.before: Collateral Damage (R) is a huge nuke that combos with Buckshot to nearly one-shot you if you're already poked. Play far from minions he can line up his R through, keep Tumble ready to break line-of-sight, and never fight inside his Smoke Screen.
edits.after: Collateral Damage (R) is a 100s nuke that combos with End of the Line to nearly one-shot a poked Vayne. His bullets cannot pass through units, so keep minions between you, and never fight inside a Smoke Screen you cannot see out of.

edits.before: This is your turning point — once your Blade of the Ruined King and Silver Bolts come online you start winning even trades, since his burst is on cooldown and your %-health DPS ramps. Bait his Buckshot, Tumble to reset, then commit when his Q and R are down.
edits.after: This is your turning point — once your Blade of the Ruined King and Silver Bolts come online you start winning even trades, since his burst is on cooldown and your %-health DPS ramps. Bait End of the Line, Tumble to reset, then commit in the 6-13s while his Q is down.

edits.before: Graves owns Levels 1-2 — his double-shot autos plus Buckshot (Q) out-trade you hard and Smoke Screen (W) blinds your autos and Silver Bolts to nothing. Sit at range and just farm.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are yours — he has one ability and must reload after four bullets, so Tumble in, land three Silver Bolts, and step out before End of the Line (Q) is back.

edits.before: Blind you with Smoke Screen so your autos and Bolts whiff
edits.after: Cut your sight with Smoke Screen and slow you on impact

edits.before: Burst you with double-shot autos + Buckshot before Silver Bolts online
edits.after: Burst you with his four-bullet autos plus End of the Line early

edits.before: Use Tumble to reset autos and dodge Buckshot/Collateral Damage lines
edits.after: Use Tumble to reset autos and dodge his End of the Line shells

edits.before: His dash + armor stacks. Engage when it's down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Quickdraw is 16s at rank 1 but refreshes off his autos — count his bullets too.

edits.before: Graves wastes Quickdraw — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Silver Bolts is true damage — his armour stacking does nothing.

notes: Biggest defect here was a fabricated ability name the packet did not flag: Graves's Q was called 'Buckshot' in four separate strings — the real name is End of the Line. Second, 'Smoke Screen blinds your autos and Silver Bolts' is not in Riot's text (sight-range reduction plus an impact slow) and it changes how a player fights inside it; the mirror agent found the same boilerplate on other Graves pages and recommended a global sweep for the word 'blind' — I agree, several strings I could not touch here probably carry it too.
